item.title: Equest Holds Run for the Roses Blue Ribbon Gala April 25
item.description: Equest holds Run for the Roses Blue Ribbon Gala at Gilley's Dallas raising funds for their equine support for disabled children and vets.

item.title: Dallas Whiskey Riot Returns to Fair Park March 14

item.title: Mansfield Summit Gets Free Burgers at Hat Creek
item.description: Mansfield Summit high school basketball team, coaches, teachers and students get free Hat Creek burgers March 12-13.

item.title: New Duncanville Assistant Police Chief Robert "Bobby" Byrd
item.description: Duncanville Police Department has promoted Lt. Robert "Bobby" Bird as their new Assistant Chief of Police effective March 8.

item.title: Roland Parrish Honored with Oak Cliff Lions Humanitarian Award
